title: Hackington Lancaster Memorial
location_name: St Stephen's Church, Hackington, Canterbury, Kent
memorial_details:
Marble tablet to Sgt R.D.J.C. Carling inside St Stephen's Church, Hackington (Canterbury), Kent.

Carling is commemorated on a marble tablet in St Stephen's Church at Hackington.
narrative: Lancaster ME743 of 44 Squadron, coded KM-G, departed Dunholme Lodge at 2257 on 27 June 1944 for the V-weapon site at Marquise. On the return leg, the aircraft was intercepted at 5200m north of Dunkirk at 0110 on 28 June by Obstleutnant Helmut Lent, Kommodore of NJG3 — his 101st confirmed claim. The aircraft crashed into the North Sea. All seven crew were killed. Sgt R.D.J.C.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Obstlt Helmut Lent (Kommodore NJG3), his 101st claim
